title: 新加坡副总理：财富枢纽竞争加剧 须更快行动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We talk about the uncertainty in the world today. How is Singapore positioning itself?
segments.zh: 我们谈到当今世界的不确定性。新加坡如何定位自己？

segments.en: How is it capitalizing on its stability in that positioning?
segments.zh: 它如何利用自身稳定性来定位？

segments.en: Well, I think it's true that the world is becoming increasingly fragmented.
segments.zh: 我认为世界确实正变得越来越碎片化。

segments.en: And therefore, there are challenges, there are emerging that we have never seen before.
segments.zh: 因此，我们正面临前所未有的挑战。

segments.en: The world has become a lot more uncertain, a lot more volatile, unpredictable.
segments.zh: 世界变得更加不确定、更加波动、难以预测。

segments.en: But despite all these challenges, they continue to be a lot of good opportunities.
segments.zh: 但尽管有这些挑战，仍存在许多良好机遇。

segments.en: And the key is for countries during Singapore to be able to be nimble, to change their depth quickly, to see some of these opportunities.
segments.zh: 关键在于各国，包括新加坡，要能灵活应变，快速调整，抓住其中一些机遇。

segments.en: From Singapore's point of view, for example, we've always been hub, we are hub city, we are hub for businesses, we are financial hub, we are also hub for logistics, supply chain.
segments.zh: 例如，从新加坡的角度看，我们一直是枢纽城市，是商业枢纽、金融枢纽，也是物流和供应链枢纽。

segments.en: So in the midst of this reorganization and supply chain investment flows, I think the hub position is going to be to play a very important role.
segments.zh: 因此，在供应链和资金流动的重组中，我认为枢纽地位将发挥非常重要的作用。

segments.en: And underlying all this is really the element of trust.
segments.zh: 而这一切的基础其实是信任要素。

segments.en: Singapore has always been known as a reliable partner.
segments.zh: 新加坡一直被视为可靠的合作伙伴。

segments.en: We are trusted and we are efficient, we are nimble, we are able to move fast.
segments.zh: 我们值得信赖、高效敏捷，能够快速行动。

segments.en: So I think that is our strength. So we did the economic strategy review to be positions in the project economy, to see how we can anchor on trust
segments.zh: 所以这是我们的优势。我们进行了经济战略评估，以在项目经济中定位，探索如何锚定信任

segments.en: and push ahead with our restructure. It is also a hub for wealth management and that's a lot of competition for that, right?
segments.zh: 并推进我们的结构调整。这也是财富管理的中心，竞争非常激烈，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, Hong Kong case in point, it seems to be the default.
segments.zh: 以香港为例，它似乎是默认选择。
